parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: Counts slot name to use for differential expression (e.g., filt)

parameters.name: Contrasts column name
parameters.description: Metadata column containing group variables for differential expression (up to 2 columns for 2-factor analysis)

parameters.name: Contrasts for comparison
parameters.description: Specify contrasts in the format group1-group2,group1-group3 (comma-separated)
parameters.help_text: These values must be in the contrasts column

parameters.name: Covariates column names
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns to be used as covariates in linear modeling; must include the contrast column

parameters.name: sub count type
parameters.description: If count_type is a list, specify the sub count type within the list

parameters.name: Sample ID Column Name
parameters.description: Column name in sample metadata for sample IDs

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column name in counts table for feature IDs (e.g., gene)

parameters.name: Samples to Include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of samples to include

parameters.name: Input in log counts
parameters.description: Set TRUE if counts are already log2-transformed

parameters.name: Return mean and sd
parameters.description: Return group means and standard deviations in addition to DE estimates

parameters.name: voom normalization method
parameters.description: Normalization method for differential expression. edgeR methods are applied with calcNormFactors before voom; limma methods are passed to voom normalize.
